provenance.source: Retained fixture for the trivial renovate digest-only bump, carrying the digest pin from joryirving/home-ops#8001 (whose live PR has since collided with unrelated repository content) together with the kustomize deployment consuming the same image.

pr_json.title: chore(deps): update digest sha256:abc1234 (no version bump)
pr_json.body: Refreshes the pinned image digest without changing the image tag.

files.content:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: api
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: api
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: ghcr.io/acme/api:v1.42.0@sha256:2222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
              protocol: TCP
          env:
            - name: LOG_LEVEL
              value: info
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 256Mi
            limits:
              cpu: "1"
              memory: 1Gi

# Pinned image digests for the production overlay.
# Regenerated by renovate — do not edit by hand.
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: image-digests
  namespace: production
data:
  api: ghcr.io/acme/api:v1.42.0@sha256:2222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222
  worker: ghcr.io/acme/worker:v1.42.0@sha256:3333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333333
